steps.title: Open Admin
steps.body: Account is the umbrella; Property holds day-to-day config; Data streams feed the property.

steps.title: Open Data streams
steps.body: This table lists web/app streams for the property. Open one stream for Measurement ID / tag instructions.

steps.title: Back to Home
steps.body: Home shows the unified Merchandise Store view fed by those streams.

steps.title: Open a table report
steps.body: Open Events or Traffic acquisition. Scan the table: row labels vs numeric columns.

steps.title: Name the dimension
steps.body: Point to a row label (Event name, Session source…). That is a dimension — a descriptive label.

steps.title: Name the metric
steps.body: Point to a numeric column (Event count, Sessions, Users…). That is a metric — a number.

steps.body: Open a user-related report and note how small slices can threshold when identity features apply.

steps.title: Admin checklist area
steps.body: Treat Setup Assistant as reminders — verify with Realtime/DebugView.

steps.title: Streams must exist
steps.body: Collection starts with a configured data stream.

steps.title: Prove collection
steps.body: Realtime confirms hits independently of checklist greens.

steps.title: Events admin
steps.body: Inspect event names and parameters available in the property.

steps.title: Prefer recommended names
steps.body: Map one business action to a recommended event when it fits — before inventing custom names.

steps.title: Debug a parameter
steps.body: Use DebugView to confirm a parameter actually arrives on the event payload.

steps.title: Web stream Enhanced measurement
steps.body: Open Enhanced measurement toggles on a web stream (read-only on demo if needed).

steps.title: Relate to events list
steps.body: Open Events and spot auto-collected interactions that EM can cover (scroll, outbound, etc.).

steps.title: Tag ownership
steps.body: Remember EM is stream toggles — custom business events still often need GTM/gtag.

steps.title: Open DebugView
steps.body: Admin → DebugView. Only debug-flagged devices appear here.

steps.title: Events admin
steps.body: Compare what you expect to collect vs Events configuration.

steps.title: Realtime backup check
steps.body: Realtime confirms recent activity for the property overall.

steps.title: Identity reporting context
steps.body: Find identity / User-ID related admin or reporting context in the demo.

steps.title: Contrast Signals
steps.body: Open Google Signals related settings/docs path — different identity system than your login User-ID.

steps.title: Debug the ID param
steps.body: Plan to verify user_id on login events in DebugView on your own implementation.

steps.title: Demo screenshot 4
steps.body: Study this demo-account screen. Open the live demo to click the same UI.

steps.title: Configure your domains
steps.body: Locate configure-your-domains / linker settings on a web stream.

steps.title: Tag instructions context
steps.body: Open tag instructions — linker/cross-domain is part of how the Google tag keeps continuity.

steps.title: Campaign / referral side effects
steps.body: Broken hops often look like new sessions or referral spikes in acquisition reports.

steps.title: Check predictive availability
steps.body: Look for predictive metrics/audiences; note if greyed out on thin demo data.

steps.title: Explore activation ideas
steps.body: Open Explore — predictive audiences are often used for activation, not just charts.

steps.title: Advertising adjacency
steps.body: When eligible, predictive audiences connect to Ads-style activation after linking.
